upgradePath.bridgeCondition: installs older than June 2026 upgrade to 2026.9.5 first, run its Doctor, then latest; latest Doctor stops on retired config keys and points back to this bridge (docs/install/updating.md@v2026.9.7:20-32)
upgradePath.bridgeApplies: yes: the runtime is the fork 2026.7.1 (config meta.lastTouchedVersion 2026.7.1), but the mounted state is older than June 2026 (config dir files from 2026-03-22 and 2026-03-29, identity/device.json 2026-05-11; read-only stat 2026-09-30). The 2026.7.1 runtime already imported tasks/runs.sqlite, flows/registry.sqlite and plugin-state/state.sqlite (only *.migrated copies remain), so the bridge is kept for retired config keys and any remaining pre-June state. Doctor imports channel state only for enabled channels and accounts (updating.md@v2026.9.7:53-58)
before: openclaw backup create --verify (old image, gateway running)
openclaw config unset channels.telegram.allowBots (old image; strict schema on the official image)
stop the old gateway container; keep and rename it, never rm (Doctor needs sole ownership of the state)
upgradePath.preStartRunner: docker compose -f deploy/dokploy.production.yml run -T --rm --no-deps --entrypoint node openclaw-gateway dist/index.js <command>: this step's image, mounts and env, no gateway running (docs/install/docker.md@v2026.9.5:185-196)
upgradePath.preStartReason: the 2026.9.5 gateway runs startup migrations and plugin convergence before readiness (docker.md@v2026.9.5:230-233), and plugins must be installed before their migrations run (updating.md@v2026.9.7:58); with no gateway running, plugins install saves the install for the next start (docs/cli/plugins/install.md@v2026.9.5:15-17)
upgradePath.preStartStop: if a plugins install refuses because the config is invalid, stop and roll back; do not run doctor --fix first, because Doctor removes channel config left dangling by a missing plugin (docs/cli/doctor/checks.md@v2026.9.5:64)
upgradePath.start: Dokploy deploy of this compose; the gateway starts serving only now
after: openclaw plugins list (discord, slack, groq-provider present)

upgradePath.release: v2026.9.7 = GitHub Latest (draft=false, prerelease=false, published 2026-09-30T04:44:14Z); registry read 2026-09-30: tags 2026.9.7 and latest both resolve to this index digest, amd64 revision label = peeled tag commit
upgradePath.gate: only after step 1 Doctor passes and 2026.9.5 serves healthy; re-read GitHub Latest and the ghcr.io index digest before the pin PR and again before deploy, and pin a newer stable with its own registry-read digest if one exists
upgradePath.startNote: this image's entrypoint (docker-entrypoint.mjs) runs doctor --fix --non-interactive before the compose gateway command (docs/install/docker.md@v2026.9.7:228-234)

phase1Config.status: desired runtime config, not applied yet; apply with openclaw config set after step 1
notes: heartbeat: target telegram needs an explicit to (chat id, stored as a string) and accountId on multi-account channels, which must match a configured account or delivery is skipped (docs/gateway/heartbeat.md@v2026.9.5:85-87,241-254,296,305-311); the live Telegram channel has one account, default (key read 2026-09-30)

${NAME} is substituted from the gateway env; a missing or empty name stays unresolved with a warning (docs/gateway/configuration/environment-variables.md@v2026.9.5:45-58), so LITELLM_API_KEY and TELEGRAM_HOME_CHANNEL must be set in the Dokploy env before this is applied

rollback.imageNote: local-only on the docker-viewport daemon (this reference resolves; the ghcr.io/ form does not); never prune it
rollback.stateNote: an image rollback does not undo Doctor migrations; restore the verified pre-upgrade state backup together with this image
